Native validation of actor-owned Temple of Sinnoh removal via Field Blower and Stadium replacement via Chaotic Swell remains outstanding.
Faba non-Hood target families remain intentionally unsupported by this prototype.

Current Agent49 public event receipts expose known Ability-use history only for actor-owned Pokémon, not opponent-owned Pokémon; therefore Faba-to-Jet-to-Wobbuffet cannot distinguish a spent Radiant Eternatus CRZ 105 Climactic Gate from an unused one. Keep the line heuristic and blocked pending native evidence or a richer public receipt.
